Title: Virtual Showroom
PDF_Text: CLO-SET Virtual Showroom Guide Copyright 2024 CONFIDENTIAL List of Content This guideline explains different workflows of making the virtual showroom via CLO-SET Fundamentals CLO-SET Virtual Showroom Workflow Method 1 By taking the pictures of your real showroom Method 2 By using the VS background preset provided by CLO-SET Method 3 By building the virtual showroom in CLO and export it to CLO-SET Method 4 By building the virtual showroom from 3rd party software and export it to CLOSET CONFIDENTIAL Fundamentals CLO-SET Virtual Showroom Workflow Copyright 2024 CONFIDENTIAL Fundamentals CLO-SET Virtual Showroom Workflow 1. In CLO-SET virtual showroom, you will be able to create 2 types of the background environment. Please well prepare the 2D or 3D images accordingly 2D Image image ratio : 16:9 Resolution: up to 8192px * 4096px, 100mb File format: png, svg, jpg, jpeg, webp the image can be taken by smart phone & professional camera 3D Panoramic Image image ratio : 16:9 Resolution: up to 8192px * 4096px, 100mb File format: png, svg, jpg, jpeg, webp, HDRI the image can be taken by smart phone, professional camera, & the camera with panoramic features Copyright 2024 CONFIDENTIAL 2. Please also prepare the contents which will be showcased in the virtual showroom in advanced 3D Files Supported File format: CLO default format e.g. zprj, zpac, zfab etc. Common 3D format, e.g. glb, obj, fbx etc. Please read this manual for details HERE 2D Files Supported File format: jpg, png, jpeg, gif Fundamentals CLO-SET Virtual Showroom Workflow Copyright 2024 CONFIDENTIAL 3. Upload all 3D files to the workroom in CLO-SET a. Click the upload button on the upper left of workroom b. select to upload single or multiple files c. attach the file from your computer A B Fundamentals CLO-SET Virtual Showroom Workflow Copyright 2024 CONFIDENTIAL 3. Upload all 3D files to the workroom in CLO-SET d. Once the styles are uploaded, go to its content page and edit its description & all basic info at the left hand corner. the info will be displayed in the virtual showroom lastly Fundamentals CLO-SET Virtual Showroom Workflow Copyright 2024 CONFIDENTIAL 4. create a new assortment, and put all uploaded 3D file to the assortment a. Click create assortment on the top left of workroom level b. A new assortment will be created Fundamentals CLO-SET Virtual Showroom Workflow Copyright 2024 CONFIDENTIAL 4. create a new assortment, and put all the uploaded 3D file to the assortment a. Go back to the workroom and select all 3D files b. click assortment in the toggle bar c. select the assortment you have newly created d. all 3D files will be linked to the assortment A B C Fundamentals CLO-SET Virtual Showroom Workflow Copyright 2024 CONFIDENTIAL 5. In the assortment, click Create Virtual Showroom on the top right to start the setup Fundamentals CLO-SET Virtual Showroom Workflow Copyright 2024 CONFIDENTIAL 6. Firstly, please complete the basic information and EnvironmentNameEnvironmentthe background of the showroomcan be either 2D or 3D imageswhen you click select, you can attach multiple images from your desktopCustom Logo Click create when it is completed Fundamentals CLO-SET Virtual Showroom Workflow Copyright 2024 CONFIDENTIAL 7. Secondly, please complete the virtual showroom in the preview page add & edit environmentby clicking on each background thumbnail, you can switch to other environmentby clicking add space on the top, you can attach additional 2D/3D images as the background Fundamentals CLO-SET Virtual Showroom Workflow Copyright 2024 CONFIDENTIAL 7. Secondly, please complete the virtual showroom in the preview page 3D environment vieweryou are able to view the environment in 3D at the middle, if you have attached panoramic imagesthe navigation would be same as 3D content live viewerLeft/ Right button: rotationWheel : Zoom in or out Add contentby clicking the cross icon, you can add 3D & 2D contents in the environment Fundamentals CLO-SET Virtual Showroom Workflow Copyright 2024 CONFIDENTIAL 7. Secondly, please complete the virtual showroom in the preview page For adding 3D content, A. rotate your view point to the specific area B. click 3D content of the cross icon C. drag one of the 3D file to the environment A B C Fundamentals CLO-SET Virtual Showroom Workflow Copyright 2024 CONFIDENTIAL 7. Secondly, please complete the virtual showroom in the preview page For adding 3D content, D. the new tag is added on the environment, you can drag and match it to the garment in the environment E. click edit to adjust the content a. the display name b. to replace it as another content if needed c. the sport icon color and shape F. click save to complete the edit E F Fundamentals CLO-SET Virtual Showroom Workflow Copyright 2024 CONFIDENTIAL 7. Secondly, please complete the virtual showroom in the preview page For adding 2D content, A. rotate your view point to the specific angle B. click 2D content of the cross icon C. the tag of the 2D content is added in the environment, you can drag and match it to the specific garment D. you edit the content at the right hand column a. displayed name b. attach the 2D content from your desktop c. description of the content d. spot icon color & shape E. click save to complete the edit A B C D Fundamentals CLO-SET Virtual Showroom Workflow Copyright 2024 CONFIDENTIAL 7. Secondly, please complete the virtual showroom in the preview page For adding Navigation,a new tag will be added in the environmentwhen the virtual showroom is published, visitor can click this tag to access to another environment/another showroom For adding other content,a new tag will be added in the environment, which will redirect the visitor to another hyperlink (URL) Fundamentals CLO-SET Virtual Showroom Workflow Copyright 2024 CONFIDENTIAL 8. Finally, you can publish the completed virtual showroom ro live, and share it to other people a. Click publish to live on the upper right corner b. the published virtual showroom can be shared by hyperlink at the right bottom corner Fundamentals CLO-SET Virtual Showroom Workflow Copyright 2024 CONFIDENTIAL 8. Method 4 By building the virtual showroom from other 3D modelling software and export it to CLO-SET Example A Example B Copyright 2024 CONFIDENTIAL Method 4 By building the virtual showroom from other 3D modelling software and export it to CLO-SET 1. Open Blender > Select General environment > Delete the cube placed in the center of the window > File > Import > GLTF/GLB 1. Open Blender > Select General environment 2. Delete the cube placed in the center of the window 3. File > Import > GLTF/GLB Copyright 2024 CONFIDENTIAL Method 4 By building the virtual showroom from other 3D modelling software and export it to CLO-SET 3. Build up your 3D showroom in blender a. Similar to CLO, we will have 3D window where contains our showroom, lights, camera, etc. on the LHS. On the Top-RHS, it is similar to CLO Object Browser, where contains a list of things inside the current project, and when we click on any of them, we can find its data and we can adjust them in the Bottom-RHS window (eg. increase the scale of the showroom to have a wider showroom). Copyright 2024 CONFIDENTIAL Method 4 By building the virtual showroom from other 3D modelling software and export it to CLO-SET 4. Re-locate the camera to the center of the showroom: a. Select the Camera in Object Browser > adjust the Location and Rotation. It should be placed inside the showroom, and you can imagine that the position of the camera is the placement that you are standing in the space. A. Suggest that the camera should be placed 90 degrees perpendicular to the ground, so that when rendering 360 degrees, the camera will rotate 360 degrees around the y axis. B. The view/scene that the camera is determined to point at in the 1st frame will be the main face of the Virtual Showroom. This means that when we open the showroom on CLOSET, we will see that scene first A A B Copyright 2024 CONFIDENTIAL Method 4 By building the virtual showroom from other 3D modelling software and export it to CLO-SET 5. Render the 3D showroom as panorama image a. You can refer on the tutorial here to render in Blender: LINK b. Adjust/Set up some recommended setting for the camera and then you can start rendering: 1. Change Render Engine to Cycles (Default is Eevee) 2. Change Render Image Resolution. Should keep the ratio is 2:1 3. Change the Camera Lens Type to Panoramic & Panorama Type to Equirectangular 4. Start Rendering out: Go to Render > Render Image 1 2 3 4 CONFIDENTIAL Thank you
PDF_Summary: ach environment, you can adjust the position, rotation, and scale of the environment. You can also add additional images to create a panoramic effect. Once you are satisfied with the virtual showroom, click "Save" to finalize it. 8. After saving, you can view and navigate through the virtual showroom by clicking on the "Preview" button. You can use the arrow keys or mouse to move around the showroom and view the uploaded 3D files. 9. To share the virtual showroom with others, you can click on the "Share" button and generate a unique URL. You can also customize the showroom's appearance by changing the background color and adding a custom logo. 10. In addition to the virtual showroom, you can also create 360-degree videos of the showroom by clicking on the "360 Video" button. This feature allows you to create dynamic presentations of your products. 11. Finally, it is important to note that all uploaded files and information in the virtual showroom are confidential and should not be shared without proper authorization. The important information extracted from the PDF includes the different methods of creating a virtual showroom using CLO-SET, the requirements for background images, supported file formats for 3D and 2D files, steps for uploading and organizing files in the workroom, creating assortments, and setting up the virtual showroom. It also includes instructions for completing basic information, customizing the environment, previewing and sharing the virtual showroom, and creating 360-degree videos.

PDF_Summary: The document is a set of instructions for setting up the structure and permissions of a CLO-SET group. The group consists of different levels of spaces tailored to the fashion industry, such as Company, Brand, Season, and Workroom. The document provides guidelines on how to create and customize these spaces, as well as how to assign permission levels to users within the group. There are four permission levels in CLO-SET: Admin, Collaborator, Editor, and Viewer. Admins have the highest level of authority and can create, edit, and delete spaces and invite users. Collaborators have similar authority but can only create/edit/delete Season (Line) and below. Editors can edit and share workrooms and assortments, while viewers have limited view access. The document also includes information on how to invite and share access with users, as well as a recommended group structure and permission best practices for brands and vendors.
